title: Obsession
paragraphs: A poorly documented early-1950s syndicated anthology of thriller and suspense dramas. Because reliable production records are limited, individual dates and numbering are not asserted unless independently supported.

Psychological mystery/drama anthology centered on destructive fixations and personal conflict. Specialist references describe 78 programs produced for the 1950-1952 WBBM/MacGregor run. The frozen GRH container preserves 30 drama recordings plus one short synopsis/reference track, not a 31-episode historical run.

GRH documents the program through WBBM filler / early syndication (October 9, 1950 to January 8, 1951) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] and Regular Monday WBBM / syndication run (January 15, 1951 to May 12, 1952) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are C. P. MacGregor (producer on 29 recordings and host on 21 recordings), Barry Sullivan (performer on 2 recordings), Barton Yarborough (performer on 2 recordings), Elliott Lewis (performer on 2 recordings), Ann Gwynn (performer on 1 recording), Annabella (performer on 1 recording), and Bonita Granville (performer on 1 recording).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include obsession, fixation and destructive desire, death, vengeance and mortal danger, crime, murder and criminal schemes, isolation, houses, sea and confinement, supernatural or uncanny fear, and identity, amnesia and impersonation.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Postwar psychological mystery anthology, WBBM Chicago and MacGregor syndication, AFRS and AFRTS rebroadcast preservation, and Partial survival of a 78-program run.
